name: French Republic

areaKm2.note: asOf 2024: land area 538,950 km2 (AG.LND.TOTL.K2). Low/high allow for the Natural Earth polygon vs official figure and inland water (surface area is a few % larger).

population.note: asOf 2025: World Bank SP.POP.TOTL 68,720,337. World Bank figure covers metropolitan France plus the five overseas departments, which ne:FRA also includes; overseas collectivities (New Caledonia, French Polynesia) excluded.

activePersonnel.note: Ministry of the Armed Forces, Key Figures 2026 (figures 2025): 201,016 military FTEs (Army 111,585, Navy 34,587, Air and Space Force 38,508, medical, energy, other). Mid: IISS as quoted on the Wikipedia personnel list, 203,900. Gendarmerie (IISS 126,600 paramilitary) excluded.

trainedReserves.note: Key Figures 2026: 49,290 first-level operational reservists (ESR) at Dec 2025, of which Army 29,292. Low: IISS 38,100 as quoted. National Guard (~80,000 per CIA Factbook) includes gendarmerie and police reserves.

supportPersonnel.note: Active 203,900 minus infantry P roles (21,000). Covers navy and air force personnel, armour/artillery/air-defence crews, logistics, staff, training and other support.

mobilizationRatio.note: Analogy to France 1939-40 (~5 million mobilized from ~41 million, ~12%) scaled down for an all-volunteer force with no stored equipment for mass levies.

count.note: Educated guess. VBCI/Griffon mechanized infantry: ~20 infantry regiments x ~450 riflemen. (context page: https://www.defense.gouv.fr/sites/default/files/ministere-armees/Chiffres_Cle%CC%81s_2026EN-webVF.pdf)

armor.note: Between anchor 9 and 10: Leclerc composite armour, no APS.

ships.note: Between anchor 9 and 10: Nuclear carrier and SSNs, FREMM/Horizon.

fortification.note: Between anchor 9 and 10: Hardened bases, limited GBAD (SAMP/T).

logistics.note: Between anchor 9 and 10: A400M, A330 MRTT, Africa/Indo-Pacific basing.

communications.note: Between anchor 9 and 10: Syracuse IV satcom, SCORPION networked land force.

gdpPerCapita.note: asOf 2025. GDP 3,032,435,620,195 2011 int$ (World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.PP.KD x 0.8005) / population 68,720,337 = 44,127. Range +/-10%. Corrected 2026-10-29: values x1.0376 because the rebase factor was an arithmetic error (0.8005); the right factor is 0.8306 (FRED GDPDEF, 2017=100: 2011 91.478 / 2021 110.130). Figures quoted above are before the correction.

gdp.note: asOf 2025. World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.PP.KD (constant 2021 int$) 3,788,176,914,672 x 0.8005 (US GDP deflator 2011/2021) = 3,032,435,620,195 2011 int$. Range +/-10% for PPP benchmark uncertainty and the relative-price drift the rebase ignores. Corrected 2026-10-29: values x1.0376 because the rebase factor was an arithmetic error (0.8005); the right factor is 0.8306 (FRED GDPDEF, 2017=100: 2011 91.478 / 2021 110.130). Figures quoted above are before the correction.

milSpendShare.note: SIPRI via World Bank MS.MIL.XPND.GD.ZS: 2.03% of GDP in 2025 (mid), 2.01% in 2024, 1.98% in 2021. Low is the lowest of those years; high allows ~5% for NATO-definition spending above SIPRI.

industrialShare.note: asOf 2025: industry incl. construction 16.8% of GDP (NV.IND.TOTL.ZS). Range +/-1.5 pp for year-to-year variation.

foodSurplus.note: Educated guess. Large net exporter of cereals, dairy and wine; not computed from FAO balance sheets.

annualCohort.note: asOf 2025. Males reaching military age per year = male population 33,315,956 (SP.POP.TOTL.MA.IN) x share of males aged 15-19 6.590% (SP.POP.1519.MA.5Y) / 5 = 439,087. Males only (conscript-pool convention); about double if women are counted. Range +/-10%.

aircraft_fighter.note: Educated guess. Dassault Merignac Rafale line ramping toward 3-4 per month for export and French orders.

artillery.note: Educated guess. KNDS France raised CAESAR output to ~6 per month after 2022.

ships_major.note: Educated guess. Naval Group Lorient FDI frigates.

submarines.note: Educated guess. Naval Group Cherbourg Suffren class.

roadKm.note: CIA Factbook as quoted: 1,053,215 km, all paved (2011); 11,671 km motorway.

railKm.note: asOf 2021: 27,716 route-km (IS.RRS.TOTL.KM). Low allows for closures since.

majorPorts.note: CIA Factbook 2024: 66 ports, 6 large + 12 medium = 18; low counts large ports only.

merchantTonnage.note: UNCTAD 2025 as quoted: 9,943 thousand DWT under the French flag (incl. RIF register). High is an educated guess for French-owned foreign-flag tonnage (CMA CGM).

supplyRangeKm.note: Educated guess. Expeditionary logistics proven in Sahel (Barkhane over 1,000+ km lines), A400M and MRTT airlift.

draftAnimals.note: Educated guess. Horses, mules and donkeys, not from FAO data. Militarily irrelevant in 2026.

nuclearWarheads.note: FAS Status of World Nuclear Forces 2026: 280 deployed strategic + 10 reserve (carrier weapons) = 290 military stockpile (mid). High: total inventory 370 incl. up to 80 retired TN75 awaiting dismantlement.

homeDefense.note: Rubric 1.2: familiar terrain, fortified cities, population support and some depth; no harsh-climate bonus.

notes: Modern snapshot, asOf 2025 World Bank data with the Ministry of the Armed Forces Key Figures 2026 (equipment at end 2025) as the primary order-of-battle source (grade A). Population convention: metropolitan France plus overseas departments inside ne:FRA (World Bank). Money in 2011 int$ via derived:ppp-rebase-2011. ships_major = carrier + PHA + first-rank frigates; surveillance frigates (Floreal) counted as minor. drones = Group 2+ only. Infantry P-role splits are educated guesses (grade D). Gendarmerie excluded. Large donations to Ukraine (CAESAR, AMX-10RC, LRU) depressed artillery holdings. Most African bases (Chad, Senegal, Cote d'Ivoire, Mali, Niger) closed 2022-2025.
